claim: A single Tape Gateway can have up to 1,500 virtual tapes in the VTL with a maximum aggregate capacity of 1 PB.
question: How many tapes can the virtual tape library (VTL) of one Tape Gateway hold?

qualifiers.scope: per Tape Gateway, tapes in the VTL (not archived)
qualifiers.condition: tapes in the archive are not limited

evidence.quote: A single Tape Gateway can have up to 1,500 virtual tapes in the VTL with a maximum aggregate capacity of 1 PB; however there is no limit to the amount of data or number of virtual tapes you can archive.

note: The user guide quota page gives the same limits as 1,500 and 1 PiB.

claim: The minimum and maximum size of a virtual tape you can create on a Tape Gateway are 100 GiB and 15 TiB.

qualifiers.scope: per virtual tape on a Tape Gateway

evidence.quote: The minimum size and maximum size of a virtual tape you can create on a Tape Gateway is 100 GiB and 15 TiB, respectively.

claim: There is no limit to the amount or size of virtual tapes that you can archive.
question: How much data can I store in tape archives?

qualifiers.scope: archived virtual tapes of a Tape Gateway
qualifiers.condition: archived tapes only; tapes in the VTL have limits

evidence.quote: There is no limit to the amount or size of virtual tapes that you can archive.

claim: Tape Gateway supports the S3 Standard, S3 Glacier and S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes: tapes sit in S3 while the backup application writes, and are archived to Glacier or Deep Archive after you eject them.
question: What Amazon S3 storage classes does Tape Gateway support?

values.display: S3 Standard, S3 Glacier, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive

qualifiers.condition: archiving happens after the tape is ejected from the backup application

evidence.quote: Tape Gateway supports S3 Standard, S3 Glacier, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes. Data on your virtual tapes is stored in a virtual tape library in Amazon S3 when the backup application is writing data to tapes. After you eject tapes from the backup application, your tapes are archived to S3 Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

claim: A tape archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive is retrieved to S3 using the standard retrieval method typically within 12 hours.
question: How long does it take to retrieve a virtual tape archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive?

qualifiers.scope: Tape Gateway, tape archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive

evidence.quote: A tape archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive is retrieved to S3 using standard retrieval method typically within 12 hours.

claim: A tape archived in S3 Glacier is retrieved to S3 using the standard retrieval method typically within 3-5 hours.
question: How long does it take to retrieve a virtual tape archived in S3 Glacier?

qualifiers.scope: Tape Gateway, tape archived in S3 Glacier

evidence.quote: A tape archived in S3 Glacier is retrieved to S3 using standard retrieval method typically within 3-5 hours.

claim: When you create new tapes in the console or API you can set the archival storage target to S3 Glacier Deep Archive, and tapes your backup software ejects are archived to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
question: How do I use Tape Gateway with S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class?

values.display: set the archival storage target to S3 Glacier Deep Archive

qualifiers.condition: archiving starts when the backup software ejects the tape

evidence.quote: When creating new tapes through the Storage Gateway console or API, you can set the archival storage target to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. When your backup software ejects the tapes, they will be archived to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

claim: You cannot access virtual tape data with Amazon S3 or Amazon S3 Glacier APIs, but you can use the Tape Gateway APIs to manage the virtual tape library and virtual tape shelf.
question: Can I see the virtual tapes of my virtual tape library with the Amazon S3 or Amazon S3 Glacier APIs?

values.display: cannot access virtual tape data using Amazon S3 or Amazon S3 Glacier APIs

evidence.quote: No. You cannot access virtual tape data using Amazon S3 or Amazon S3 Glacier APIs. However, you can use the Tape Gateway APIs to manage your virtual tape library and your virtual tape shelf.

claim: Tape Gateway supports moving tapes from S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive, by assigning the tape in the Glacier Pool to the Deep Archive Pool in the console or API.
question: Can I move my existing virtual tapes in S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive?

values.display: moving your tapes in S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive

evidence.quote: Yes. Tape Gateway supports moving your tapes in S3 Glacier to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. You can assign the tape placed in Glacier Pool to Deep Archive Pool using AWS Storage Gateway Console or API.

claim: You cannot move a tape from S3 Glacier Deep Archive to S3 Glacier; you can retrieve it to S3 or delete it.
question: Can I move a tape in S3 Glacier Deep Archive to S3 Glacier?

values.display: cannot move a tape from S3 Glacier Deep Archive to S3 Glacier

evidence.quote: No, you cannot move a tape from S3 Glacier Deep Archive to S3 Glacier. You can retrieve a tape from S3 Glacier Deep Archive to S3 or delete a tape from S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

claim: Tape Gateway supports Write Once Read Many (WORM): you can select the WORM tape type when you create tapes manually or by automatic tape creation, and data on WORM tapes cannot be erased from the backup application, intentionally or accidentally.
question: Does Tape Gateway support Write Once Read Many (WORM) capability?

qualifiers.condition: choose the WORM tape type when creating new tapes

evidence.quote: Yes, when creating new virtual tapes manually or using automatic tape creation configuration on Tape Gateway, you can select the WORM tape type. Data on WORM virtual tapes cannot be erased intentionally or accidentally from the backup application.

claim: Tape Retention Lock prevents archived virtual tapes from being deleted for a fixed amount of time, or even indefinitely.
question: How does Tape Gateway stop archived tapes from being deleted?

evidence.quote: In addition, Tape Gateway’s Tape Retention Lock capability prevents archived virtual tapes from being deleted for a fixed amount of time, or even indefinitely.

claim: The Tape Gateway VTL interface is compatible with backup and archival applications that use the industry-standard iSCSI-based tape library interface.
question: What backup applications can I use with Tape Gateway?

evidence.quote: The VTL interface is compatible with backup and archival applications that use the industry-standard iSCSI-based tape library interface.

claim: The KMS key (CMK) that is configured to encrypt tape data cannot be changed after the tape is created.
question: Can I change the KMS key that encrypts a virtual tape?

qualifiers.scope: Tape Gateway tapes encrypted with a KMS key

evidence.quote: The configured CMK used to encrypt tape data cannot be changed after creation.

claim: Virtual tapes stored in S3 Glacier Deep Archive are replicated and stored across at least three geographically-dispersed Availability Zones, protected by 11 9s of durability.
question: What are the benefits of storing virtual tapes in AWS compared to warehousing tapes offsite?

values.display: at least three geographically-dispersed Availability Zones

qualifiers.scope: virtual tapes stored in S3 Glacier Deep Archive by Tape Gateway

evidence.quote: First, all virtual tapes stored in S3 Glacier Deep Archive are replicated and stored across at least three geographically-dispersed Availability Zones, protected by 11 9s of durability.

claim: A virtual tape deleted within three months of archiving in S3 Glacier, or within six months of archiving in S3 Glacier Deep Archive, incurs an early deletion fee; after three or six months respectively there is no charge for deletion.
question: How will I be charged for deleting an archived virtual tape?

qualifiers.scope: archived virtual tapes of Tape Gateway
qualifiers.condition: three months in S3 Glacier, six months in S3 Glacier Deep Archive

evidence.quote: If a virtual tape is deleted within three months of being archived in S3 Glacier or within six months of being archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive, you will be charged an early deletion fee. If the virtual tape has been stored for three months or longer in S3 Glacier or for six months or longer in S3 Glacier Deep Archive, there is no charge for deletion.
